places-covacho-ahumado-mallata-c.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-covacho-ahumado-mallata-c.story: 364 km from Alacón to Alacón, about 6 h 17 of riding. On the way it passes Abric del mas de Barberà, Els Secans, Valmayor IV and Mallata C. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

legend-snow-roads-scenic-route.slogan: Snow Roads Scenic Route – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-snow-roads-scenic-route.story: A mountain scenic route from Blairgowrie, Scotland to Grantown-on-Spey, Scotland, via Glenshee. Key character: Cairngorms; high passes; moorland. Surface: paved.

scenicChapters.title: Snow Roads Scenic Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 24 km this is Snow Roads Scenic Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
